title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer / Freelance Consultant

descriptions.description: Owned end-to-end delivery of project-based web and mobile applications using TanStack, Next.js, Node.js, Expo, TypeScript, React, and React Native, from product scope and UX decisions through production releases.
Delivered healthcare SaaS web and mobile features, translating business and clinical workflow requirements into production software.
Designed and integrated two healthcare applications using the Canvas API to support clinical workflows and data exchange.
Led a zero-downtime migration from a legacy platform to a unified system, validating data integrity and coordinating a phased rollout.
Built Cloudflare Worker services with KV caching, reducing redundant authentication requests and external API traffic by 800+ requests per day.
Resolved a production defect in a Supabase Edge Function notification system that sent duplicate emails to hundreds of users, restoring reliable notification delivery.
Redesigned asynchronous workflows with idempotent job execution, batching, and explicit state tracking to make scheduled serverless processing predictable.
Identified race conditions, failure modes, and process gaps in edge cron architectures, improving the reliability and maintainability of background processing.
Partnered with technical and non-technical stakeholders to define product scope, implementation priorities, UX tradeoffs, and technical feasibility, clarify requirements, and surface delivery risks.
Built an independent multimedia publishing platform with React, TypeScript, TanStack Start, Bun, and PostgreSQL, supporting content authoring, chapter organization, audio playback, and sharing.

Developed browser-based recording and audio editing tools with waveform visualization, interactive playback timelines, word-level timing controls, synchronized text playback, and mobile touch interactions.
Implemented FFmpeg media pipelines for audio and video imports, audio transcoding, noise reduction, and voice/music mixing, with background job tracking and Cloudflare R2 storage.
Integrated Stripe and PayPal checkout, creator contributions, and Stripe Connect onboarding, with payment ledger reconciliation, refund handling, and webhook deduplication.

Implemented invitation-based collaboration and content access using scoped action tokens, hashed share tokens, expiring grants, and secure cookies to control reading, editing, and contribution permissions.
Designed PostgreSQL schemas and migrations for publishing, chapter organization, collaboration, media-processing jobs, and payment records.
Provisioned application infrastructure with Terraform, Hetzner, and Cloudflare, including object storage, DNS, origin TLS, firewall rules, and asset caching.
Automated container builds and production releases with Docker and GitHub Actions, integrating Vault-based deployment secrets, database migrations, and application health checks.

Built unit and integration coverage for authorization boundaries, payment policies, audio processing, timing preservation, and route behavior, with lint, type checking, tests, and builds enforced in CI.
Created a responsive SVG composition editor with custom letterforms, shared preview/export layout, and SVG and PNG downloads with image sizing limits for mobile devices.
Built a Python web scraper for a bookstore inventory project serving students at a major university in New York City.
Shipped six customer-facing features across Discovery Topics, Talk, and Member Pages using Next.js, Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, and experimentation tooling.
Improved release confidence and delivery speed by introducing code coverage tooling, leading focused code reviews, and pairing with engineers, reducing QA cycles and cutting deployment time by 31%.
Designed, built, and maintained 10+ accessible, reusable UI components within the TED Design System, supporting consistent product experiences across teams.
Drove cross-functional collaboration with frontend, backend, design, and product partners using Agile practices to deliver features with shared ownership.
Designed and built an internal ingestion and migration tool to transition content from a legacy non-relational CMS to SharePoint, supporting the migration of 20,000+ enterprise sites.
Translated complex migration requirements into structured delivery steps, helping internal stakeholders move legacy content into a unified enterprise platform.
Delivered three internal single-page applications and supporting backend services using Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and CouchDB to streamline employee workflows.
Built accessible, data-driven user interfaces and visualizations using Vue.js, D3.js, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS to support internal enterprise platforms.
Unified legacy APIs and Cassandra data through GraphQL services that powered reusable components for forms, dashboards, and profile pages.
Strengthened backend service reliability by refactoring Node.js microservices, increasing test coverage by 85% and reducing production regressions.
Applied functional programming and test-driven development practices to produce maintainable, predictable code.
Delivered iterative product improvements in partnership with product and design teams using Agile methodologies.
Supported hiring and onboarding by developing technical assessments and onboarding documentation for new engineers.
Developed four reusable Wagtail CMS components in Python, improving content authoring efficiency for designers.
Modernized a legacy jQuery content management system to centralize documentation for the Infor Design System.
Designed and demonstrated proof-of-concept prototypes to validate new product ideas and technical approaches.
Built a progressive web application using Angular, NgRX, AWS Lambda, AWS Lex, and reactive programming patterns.
